name: 可访问性审计
description: 审计工作区浏览器面板里当前页面的可访问性：无名称的交互元素、缺 alt 的图片、只有占位词的名称、整页没有标题或没有交互角色。只读，并明确列出因能力边界而无法检查的项（对比度、焦点顺序、ARIA 状态）。

en.name: A11y Audit
en.description: Audits the page open in the workspace browser panel for accessibility problems: interactive elements with no accessible name, images without alt text, placeholder-only names, and pages with no headings or no interactive roles. Read-only, and it states explicitly which checks it cannot perform (contrast, focus order, ARIA state).
en.safetyNotes: Declares browser.cdp and agent.tool.register. browser.cdp controls the host work-panel guest and is clamped to this plugin's own view; this plugin only reads the accessibility tree through pi.browser.snapshot(), never navigates, never injects script, never screenshots and never writes files. The audit is a pure function over the flattened tree the host already produced, so nothing is sent anywhere. It reports what it cannot check instead of implying full WCAG coverage.

zh-CN.name: 可访问性审计
zh-CN.description: 审计工作区浏览器面板里当前页面的可访问性：无名称的交互元素、缺 alt 的图片、只有占位词的名称、整页没有标题或没有交互角色。只读，并明确列出因能力边界而无法检查的项（对比度、焦点顺序、ARIA 状态）。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 声明 browser.cdp 与 agent.tool.register。browser.cdp 控制宿主工作面板的 guest，且被夹取到本插件自己的视图；本插件只通过 pi.browser.snapshot() 读取可访问性树，不导航、不注入脚本、不截图、不写文件。审计是对宿主已产出的扁平树做的纯函数计算，不向任何地方发送数据。它如实报告做不到的检查项，而不是暗示覆盖了完整 WCAG。
